hero.place: Chocen · every first Sunday in December
hero.claim: A forest cross that tests you on every climb. Short, intense, and unforgiving, with steep uphills and fast technical descents.

overview.title: It is not a run. It is a challenge.
body: Mala cena Velke Verandy is a traditional forest cross in the heart of the Chocen woods. In just 4300 meters you get everything that makes trail racing memorable: steep climbs, technical descents, and roots underfoot.
The short distance tempts you to underestimate it. The profile corrects that quickly. This is a race with character for hobby runners and seasoned racers alike.

actions.label: Have a question? Contact the organizer.

cards.title: Short, but brutal
cards.description: 4300 m that force you to go hard from start to finish. No space for a gentle warm-up.

cards.title: Technical terrain
cards.description: Forest roads, narrow paths, roots, and mud. A course where technique and courage matter.

cards.title: Atmosphere and tradition
cards.description: A cold December Sunday, cheering spectators, and legendary climbs. A race with soul.

facts.description: Interval start in pairs every 15 s from 10:15.

facts.description: Adults, veterans, and youth. There is a contest for everyone.

facts.title: Entry fee

profile.title: Four climbs. Four descents. No excuses.
profile.description: An elevation profile that never lets go. Every meter of climbing is noticeable.

stats.description: Technical downhill running where confidence matters.

travel.title: By car
travel.description: Parking in the bend 1 km past Choceň towards Sruby (road 315), then 300 m on foot. Alternative: Krále Jiřího embankment, follow the green waymarks 500 m to Veranda.

travel.title: By train
travel.description: Choceň station. Through the tunnel and park, along the left bank of the Tichá Orlice (Krále Jiřího embankment) to the gamekeeper's lodge, under the railway towards Týniště, green waymark NW, 2 km in total to the race centre.

travel.title: By bus
travel.description: ČSAD station by the cinema. SW across the bridge to the left bank, then the same as from the train.

intro.title: Race notice
intro.body: One forest course and an interval start.

date.title: Date
date.body: The traditional first Sunday in December.

venue.title: Venue
venue.body: Start and finish at Velká Veranda. GPS 49°59′45″N, 16°12′10″E.

course.title: Course
course.body: Forest roads and paths, 400 m of asphalt. 200 m of climb. Marked with streamers. One course for all categories.

registration.title: Registration
registration.body: On race day you can register on site until 9:45. An online entry is valid only after the payment is received.

prizes.title: Prizes
prizes.summary: Men and women, veterans, youth and juniors
prizes.body: Cash prizes in CZK in the men's and women's categories (1st–5th) and veterans (1st–3rd).

start.title: Start
start.body: Start interval {seconds} s from 10:15. One wave, no separate kids' start. One course for all categories.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.body: On-site registration closes at 9:45. Start from 10:15. Awards at 12:20.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: We process personal data to run the race and publish results. Photos and video may be used to present the event. Objections can be sent to the organizer.

notice.title: Notice
notice.body: Participation is at your own risk. The race is not suitable for children under 6. Only those who complete the whole course without help from another person are listed in the results. Sales and stalls only with the organizer's consent.

info.title: Information
info.body: Current information is on the website. Send questions through the form; we do not publish e-mail or phone.
